description.p: ChipCutter is an offline desktop Computer-Aided Manufacturing (CAM) application and headless CLI written in Rust that converts 3D STEP B-Rep models, triangle meshes (STL, OBJ, 3MF), 2D DXF/SVG vector drawings, and built-in parametric 2D sketches into verified CNC milling, routing, V-carving, and 4th-axis rotary G-code.

ul.li: Exact f64 B-Rep, mesh, and 2D vector toolpath generation with true circular arc preservation
2.5D Facing, 2D Contour with tabs, 2D Pocket, Adaptive roughing, Rest Machining, Drilling, Helical Bore, Chamfer, Trace, and V-Carving
3-axis surface milling (Waterline, Parallel, Scallop, Pencil) and 4th-axis indexed/wrapped/simultaneous rotary milling
Interactive 3D stock-removal simulation with rapid-into-stock and gouge verification
Configurable GRBL, grblHAL ATC, and LinuxCNC G-code post-processors plus headless CLI batch builds

description.p: Phase 16 release: upgraded 4th-axis rotary toolpaths with exact direct BVH drop-cutter evaluation, adaptive midpoint chord refinement, slope-compensated cusp stepover, and 3x finer cylindrical pose subdivision; eliminated 3-axis surface finishing chord gouges with zero-gouge chord refinement, higher-resolution smoothed Scallop3D, local contour-offset Waterline3D stepdowns, and sub-cell parabolic Pencil3D ridge centering; added engagement-aware feedrate optimization (internal-arc centerline scaling, sharp-corner lookahead deceleration, radial chip-thinning boost) with Inspector controls and timeline telemetry; fixed 2.5D circular-island rest cleanup and V-Carve Z-chord refinement; isolated background GPU simulation compute onto a dedicated headless wgpu device to prevent Surface::configure panics during window resizes; and updated tutorial commands for installed chip-gui and chipcutter binaries.

Phase 15 release: added an optional wgpu Compute simulation and direct rendering backend (gpu-compute feature with zero new external dependencies and transparent exact CPU fallback), tiled WGSL compute sweepers for 2.5D Heightfield, 4th-axis Cylindrical (up to 5.8x faster at Ultra), and flat fixed-K Tri-Dexel (with lossless hybrid CPU overflow for multi-form thread undercuts), GPU BVH target rasterization and parallel-reduction stock-vs-target error metrics, zero-readback direct GPU stock rendering with instant Error Heatmap tolerance updates, VRAM-bounded GPU checkpoints, GUI backend selector and adapter status badge, and CLI --backend/--benchmark reporting.
Bug-fix release: fixed 2.5D heightfield simulation swept-interval intersection along sloped linear moves for flat endmills, eliminating false rapid/ramp stock removal artifacts on ramped entries.

Phase 14 architecture refactoring release: extracted dedicated pure-kernel internal crates (chip-bvh flat SAH BVH, chip-geom2d exact 2D polygon/Voronoi/arc kernel, and chip-stock volumetric stock engines), unified Heightfield/Tri-Dexel/Cylindrical simulation behind SimStockBackend with an axis-generic flat fixed-K Tri-Dexel span pool and zero-copy GPU vertex/buffer layouts, fixed multi-body STL/OBJ/3MF target_bodies filtering in Tri-Dexel verification, moved interactive simulation stock remeshing off the UI thread with rapid-scrub coalescing, and decomposed oversized modules across the workspace.

Phase 13 release: added four new built-in CNC machine profiles (Makera Carvera, Makera Carvera Z1, Millennium Machines Milo v2.0, and Voron Cascade) and full end-to-end Helical Thread Milling (single-point and multi-form cutters, ISO Metric and Unified UNC/UNF thread tables, internal holes and external bosses, radial tangent arc-in/out, Tri-Dexel 3D helical undercut simulation, Tool Library & Passes Inspector UI, built-in thread-mill sample, and illustrated Tutorial 18).

Bug-fix release: fixed a polyline offset panic on Relief Wave evolute cusps, enabled stock-vs-target error-volume and RMS metrics for 4th-axis cylindrical simulations, and added signed Error Heatmap rendering on 4th-axis cylindrical stock.

GUI polish and illustrated documentation release: unified collapsible card styling across the CAM Browser and right-side Inspectors, strict two-column Inspector layouts, consistent eyeball (visibility) vs. checkbox (active/inactive) semantics, universal hover tooltips across all controls, faster Error Heatmap meshing and playback deferral with clear toggle controls, an unsaved-changes confirmation dialog on window close, and an illustrated Sample Projects Gallery with per-operation completion screenshots.

Added selectable Tri-Dexel 3D volumetric CAM simulation alongside fast 2.5D heightmap simulation, quantitative stock-vs-target error-volume and RMS/MAE/P95/P99 surface deviation metrics, signed deviation Error Heatmap visualization, CLI --engine/--tolerance JSON benchmarking, and illustrated Tutorial 17.
Bug-fix release: reset all active project, model, simulation, G-code preview, and cached geometry state cleanly when opening or switching projects.

Added non-destructive per-model orientation, lay-flat, scaling, target-size fitting, and positioning for STEP solids and STL/OBJ/3MF meshes (GUI Model Transform Inspector, Mesh Import orientation preview, CLI transform-model, and associative Ctrl+R reload preservation), Setup WCS fine Z-axis clocking, and illustrated Tutorial 16.

Security hardening release: read-only built-in post-processors, sanitized G-code output paths and metadata, cumulative zip-bomb and parser complexity caps, private temporary extraction directories, and SHA-pinned release workflows.

Added Machine Definitions and per-machine tool libraries (Generic, Millennium Machines Milo v1.5 LDO Kit, Makera Carvera Air), upgrade-safe cloning and .machine.toml export/import, machine envelope/RPM diagnostics, and the Help -> About dialog.
Initial release of ChipCutter with 2.5D milling, 3-axis mesh finishing, 4th-axis rotary toolpaths, stock-removal simulation, and verified GRBL/LinuxCNC G-code post-processing.
